[[EXPERIMENT_TITLE]] - Loading Isotherm Determination Report

Experiment Information

Experiment ID: [[EXPERIMENT_ID]]

Process ID: [[PROCESS_ID]]

Start Date: [[EXPERIMENT_DATE]]

End Date / Report Generated: [[REPORT_DATE]]

Objective

Determination of loading isotherms for [[LIGAND_NAME]] binding to chromatography resin at different salt concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]) using an automated robotic workflow. Binding capacities are quantified based on supernatant concentration measurements and a calibration curve with slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]] and intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]].

Methods

Overview of Automated Workflow

The loading isotherm experiment was executed on an integrated automated platform consisting of an Opentrons OT-2 liquid handler, a UR5 robotic arm, a vacuum manifold with deep-well and filter plates, a vacuum pump, and a Tecan Spark platereader.

Reagents and General Conditions
  • Ligand: [[LIGAND_NAME]]
  • Ligand stock concentration: [[LIGAND_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Ligand concentration series: [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] (total of [[NUMBER_OF_LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] conditions)
  • Resin mass per well: [[RESIN_MASS]]
  • Equilibration buffer: [[BUFFER]] with salt [[SALT_NAME]]
  • Salt stock concentration: [[SALT_STOCK_CONCENTRATION]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]
  • Salt concentration series: [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]] (total of [[NUMBER_OF_SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] conditions)
  • Total liquid volume per well for loading: [[TOTAL_VOLUME]]
  • Incubation temperature: [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]]
  • Incubation shaker speed: [[SHAKER_SPEED_INCUBATION]]
  • Number of replicates per condition: [[REPLICATES]]
  • Measurement wavelength (Tecan Spark): [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm
Automated Workflow Description

The following sequence summarizes the automated method used to equilibrate the resin, load ligand at various salt concentrations, and measure the remaining ligand concentration:

  1. Initial equilibration setup:
    • The Opentrons OT-2 prepares and dispenses equilibration buffer ([[BUFFER]]) with specified salt concentration ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]) into a Cytiva 96-well filter plate mounted using custom labware on the OT-2.
    • The UR5 robot transfers a 96-deep-well plate ("96DeepWP") from storage to the vacuum manifold position (Pump_Pos1) and places the vacuum manifold.
    • The UR5 moves the loaded filter plate from the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos1) onto the vacuum manifold (Pump_Pos2), pairing it with the underlying deep-well plate.
    • The vacuum pump (VacuuPump) is activated at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] s to draw equilibration buffer through the resin bed.
    • A venting wait of [[VENTING_TIME]] s ensures complete pressure equilibration before the UR5 returns the filter plate to the OT-2 (OT2_Pos1).
  2. Equilibration cycles:
    • The equilibration step is repeated for [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLES]] cycles, each using an equilibration volume of [[EQUILIBRATION_VOLUME]] per well.
    • For each equilibration cycle, the OT-2 dispenses buffer, the UR5 transfers the filter plate to the vacuum manifold, and the VacuuPump runs at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[EQUILIBRATION_CYCLE_DURATION]] s, followed by venting and return of the plate to the OT-2.
  3. Pre-loading and preparation for ligand addition:
    • After completion of equilibration, the UR5 removes the vacuum manifold and returns the 96-deep-well plate to storage.
    • The OT-2 performs an additional protocol step (e.g., final buffer exchange or pre-loading step) on the equilibrated filter plate with resin.
    • A pause step prompts the operator to cover the filter plate with foil, refresh pipette tips, and empty waste, ensuring proper conditions for the subsequent ligand loading.
    • The OT-2 then runs a second protocol to dispense ligand solutions with defined [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] at the different [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] into the equilibrated resin-containing filter plate, followed by a pause to remove the foil.
  4. Ligand loading and collection of flow-through:
    • The UR5 transfers a fresh 96-deep-well plate to the vacuum manifold position (Pump_Pos1) and places the vacuum manifold.
    • The UR5 moves the ligand-loaded filter plate from the OT-2 (OT2_Pos1) to the vacuum manifold (Pump_Pos2).
    • The VacuuPump runs at speed [[PUMP_SPEED]] for [[PUMP_DURATION]] s to draw the ligand-containing solutions through the resin into the underlying deep-well plate, collecting the flow-through for each condition.
    • A venting wait of [[VENTING_TIME]] s is applied, after which the UR5 transfers the filter plate to storage and removes the vacuum manifold.
    • The UR5 then transfers the deep-well plate containing the flow-through to the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos5) for further processing if required.
  5. Preparation of measurement plate:
    • The UR5 places an empty measurement microplate ("WP1") from storage onto the OT-2 deck (OT2_Pos1).
    • The OT-2 executes a measurement preparation protocol, e.g., dilution of flow-through samples from the deep-well plate into the measurement plate, suitable for absorbance or fluorescence readout on the Tecan Spark.
  6. Spectroscopic measurement:
    • The UR5 transfers the prepared measurement plate (WP1) from the OT-2 to the Tecan Spark plate reader.
    • The Tecan Spark closes its door and runs the predefined measurement method at [[MEASUREMENT_WAVELENGTH]] nm to quantify the residual ligand concentration in each well.
    • After completion, the plate is returned to storage by the UR5.
  7. Calculation of loading isotherms:
    • Ligand concentrations in the flow-through are converted from absorbance using the calibration curve (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]).
    • The amount of ligand bound to the resin is determined by mass balance between the initial [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] and measured supernatant concentrations, accounting for [[TOTAL_VOLUME]] and [[RESIN_MASS]].
    • Loading isotherms are constructed for each salt concentration ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]), averaging over [[REPLICATES]] replicates.

Results

Loading Isotherms for [[LIGAND_NAME]] on Resin at Different [[SALT_NAME]] Concentrations
[[PLOT_1]]

Figure 1: Loading isotherms for [[LIGAND_NAME]] binding to resin at different [[SALT_NAME]] concentrations ([[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[SALT_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]). Each curve represents the equilibrium binding capacity as a function of initial ligand concentration ([[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]] [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATION_UNIT]]), calculated using calibration parameters (slope [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_SLOPE]], intercept [[CALIBRATION_CURVE_INTERCEPT]]) and experimental settings (resin mass [[RESIN_MASS]], total volume [[TOTAL_VOLUME]], incubation time [[INCUBATION_TIME]], incubation temperature [[INCUBATION_TEMPERATURE]]).

Comments / Interpretation

Summarize how the binding capacity varies with [[SALT_CONCENTRATIONS]] and [[LIGAND_CONCENTRATIONS]], and note any trends in the shape of the isotherms (e.g., Langmuir-like behavior, curvature at high ligand concentration, or salt-dependent changes in maximum capacity and affinity).
